mechanism: Primaquine can cause hemolytic anemia and acute kidney injury, which may compromise renal function and increase dapagliflozin accumulation; dapagliflozin increases urinary glucose and osmotic diuresis, potentially worsening dehydration and renal perfusion during primaquine-induced hemolysis.
action: Monitor renal function, hemoglobin levels, and hydration status closely; ensure adequate fluid intake; consider alternative antimalarials if possible or use dapagliflozin with caution in patients receiving primaquine.
